items.title: Cards to deliver
items.description: Product card records passed by value. Chain this after a scraper Actor: a run cannot read another run's dataset with standard permissions.

outputConnector.title: Destination
outputConnector.description: Where to write the cards. Pick a connector you have authorized: a Notion workspace, a Supabase project, a Slack channel. Your credentials stay on the Apify side and never reach this Actor.

targetTable.title: Target table or collection
targetTable.description: Name of the table, database or channel to write into. Ignored by services that do not need it.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Connect, list the tools your service exposes, report which one would be used, and write nothing. Use this the first time you attach a connector.
